description: PAID ($0.0045 USDC via x402, paid automatically). Live prediction markets from Polymarket: for each open market, every outcome with its price (the price of one share, 0-1 USDC, read as the market's implied probability), 24h and total volume, liquidity, closing date and a link. Search by topic, or omit the query for the markets with the most 24h volume. A query that matches no open market answers 404 and is not charged. Market prices, not forecasts — not financial advice. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

query.description: What to look for (e.g. bitcoin, fed rates, election). Omit for the markets with the most 24h volume
